databasePolicy.applyAtomicity: lock trip_plan and candidate; verify owner/run/base/expected active/expiry/unapplied; CAS active_schedule_version_id and selected_at in one transaction

idempotencyPolicy.scope: canonicalSub + uppercase method + normalized path + Idempotency-Key
idempotencyPolicy.sameKeySamePayload: replay exact status, Location/Retry-After or ETag/Location, and body without rerunning worker/apply
idempotencyPolicy.concurrentSamePayload: single winner; processing loser gets 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED and Retry-After: 1
idempotencyPolicy.activeRunConcurrency: at most one queued/running run for owner+trip+base+targetDay; DB arbiter loser is 409 ACTIVE_RUN_CONFLICT
idempotencyPolicy.applyConcurrency: trip row lock plus expected active CAS; exactly one candidate can advance the expected version; losers are deterministic 409

hashPolicy.commandInputHash: compute_run_inputs.command_input_hash: lowercase SHA-256 of immutable versioned structured command snapshot accepted by Spring
hashPolicy.mcpInputHash: lowercase SHA-256 of the exact redacted canonical MCP wire input assembled from that snapshot and normalized facts
hashPolicy.separation: commandInputHash and mcpInputHash are distinct fields with distinct inputs; equality is allowed only by digest coincidence and never by field aliasing
hashPolicy.restart: worker retry/restart reads only Issue #108 immutable compute_run_inputs snapshot; request body, prompt text and mutable trip state are not reconstructed as command input
hashPolicy.exposure: both hashes are non-secret lowercase 64-hex provenance; raw command and MCP payload are not returned
